manaNeeded: {4} available in at least three different colors
description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, ensuring to spend at least three different colors of mana to cast it, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter the battlefield with at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
When Crystalline Crawler enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{W}{U}{B} and the remaining mana in any combination of color(s).
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Crystalline Crawler to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
